subject: Kickoff: Distracting Control as our RL robustness gate
body:
Ivo, team,

Kicking off the robustness-benchmark track. Our pixel-based RL agents look great on clean dm_control and then fall over on anything visually messy. The Distracting Control Suite is the fix: it extends dm_control with static or dynamic distractions -- changing colors, backgrounds drawn from the DAVIS 2017 training images, and camera-pose perturbations -- with controllable difficulty levels, while keeping the standard dm_control environment API so our agents plug in unchanged.

Goal: make this the standard robustness gate for the agents-rl portfolio. Every agent we promote in Q3 should carry a distracting-control score next to its clean score.

Milestones: suite integrated and validated May 15, all current agents benchmarked through June, gate proposal to the portfolio leads July 8.

Ulla
